entities.name: Dongdan Kingdom
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: Dongdan (926–936), was a puppet kingdom established by the Liao dynasty to rule the former realm of Balhae (Bohai) in eastern Manchuria. The territory was later absorbed into the Liao dynasty.
